name: Shenming de Yitian Shijie
source:
This is the world created by God. All lives enjoy the peace under the aegis of God. Here, God's Order is in everywhere. You have to Obey the rules, or you will die.
As you've been forgot all the past, do you want to follow the guidance and live invariable life in this God's place?

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=686330197]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
translation:
这是上帝创造的世界。众生在上帝庇护下享受和平，上帝的秩序遍布每个角落。你必须遵守规则，否则就会死去。

当你遗忘了一切过去，你愿意遵循指引，在这个上帝的国度过一成不变的生活吗？

[来源：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=686330197]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
